hero.title: Build lazy-loaded websites with TypeScript × Vue
hero.lead: This page is the src/init example. Edit src/init/view/index.html and save; the browser updates in about a second.
hero.hint: Author animation (animateModel/author.ts): try clicking the book, violin, car or Digimon

steps.d: Edit src/init/view/index.html; the browser reloads when you save.
Right-click src/<project>/view → "New Frontend Page..." and enter a name.
Switch "wT debug" to release in the status bar; dir/ holds the files to deploy.

demos.title: Simple examples
demos.lead: One feature per card: try it at the top, the minimal code is below.

bind.d: v-model connects an input to data.

calc.d: funComputed in controllers works out the total; $f.money formats it.

model.d: Logic lives in model/indexTsc and the view calls it as $m (downloaded on demand).

cmd.d: addCommand in main.ts defines site-wide directives: v-upm flashes when the value changes.

task.d: StartNew → ContinueWith runs in order; each step waits for the previous one.

project.d: The aa project is its own aa.min.js, downloaded when you press the button.

url.d: Keep state in the URL so a reload or a shared link restores it.
url.none: No parameter in the URL yet

assets.d: Image library libSrc() and jsonDoc config.get(), bundled automatically.

jwt.d: src/models/JWTCrypto is a site-wide package loaded on demand with $t.import.m.js.

htmlts.d: <script lang="ts"> in index.html (and an external src file) is compiled with the view: type checking and imports work; $view gives you index.ts's export default and this component's $t (data, action).

code.htmlts:
<script lang="ts">
import {pb} from "../../models/vueSDK";
// $view.vue = index.ts 的 export default
const keys = Object.keys($view.vue.data || {});
$view.created($t=>{
    $t.tsInline = "data = " + keys.join(", ");
});
</script>
<script lang="ts" src="./index.script.ts"></script>

// index.script.ts
export default function($view:WtScriptView<typeof indexView>){
    $view.ready($t=>{ $t.tsSrc = $t.text!().demos.items.htmlts.t; });
}
